segments.speaker: SPEAKER
segments.en: Thank you for calling the Tourist Line.

segments.speaker: SPEAKER
segments.en: There are many different ways of getting round the city and we'd like to suggest some you may not have thought of.

segments.speaker: SPEAKER
segments.en: How about a city trip by boat?

segments.speaker: SPEAKER
segments.en: There are four main stopping points- from west to east: stop A Green Banks, stop B City Bridge, stop C Roman Landing and stop D Newtown. You can find the main booking office at stop A.

segments.speaker: SPEAKER
segments.en: The first boat leaves at 8 a.m. and the last one at 6.30 p.m.

segments.speaker: SPEAKER
segments.en: There are also many attractions you can visit along the river.

segments.speaker: SPEAKER
segments.en: At Stop A, if you have time, you can visit the fine 16th century palace here built for the king with its beautiful formal gardens.

segments.speaker: SPEAKER
segments.en: It's very near the booking office.

segments.speaker: SPEAKER
segments.en: Now you can enjoy every corner of this superb residence.

segments.speaker: SPEAKER
segments.en: Stop B Why don't you visit Tower Restaurant with its wide range of refreshments?

segments.speaker: SPEAKER
segments.en: This is a place where you can sit and enjoy the wonderful views over the old commercial and banking centre of the city.

segments.speaker: SPEAKER
segments.en: Stop C is the area where, in the first century AD, invading soldiers crossed the river; this was much shallower than it is now.

segments.speaker: SPEAKER
segments.en: That's why this area is called Roman Landing.

segments.speaker: SPEAKER
segments.en: There's an interactive Museum to visit here with a large shop which has a good range of local history books.

segments.speaker: SPEAKER
segments.en: At the furthest point of the trip, stop D, the most exciting place to visit is the new Entertainment Complex with seven-screen cinema, bowling alley and video games arcade.

segments.speaker: SPEAKER
segments.en: Q/8 Besides the boat tours, there are city buses.

segments.speaker: SPEAKER
segments.en: Two companies offer special services: The Top Bus Company runs all its tours with a live commentary in English.

segments.speaker: SPEAKER
segments.en: Tours leave from 8.30 a.m. every 20 minutes.

segments.speaker: SPEAKER
segments.en: There are departures from Central Station, Castle Hill Q/9 and Long Walk.

segments.speaker: SPEAKER
segments.en: This is a hop-on hop-off service and tickets are valid for 24 hours.

segments.speaker: SPEAKER
segments.en: For further details call Top Bus on 0208 9447810.

segments.speaker: SPEAKER
segments.en: The Number One Sightseeing Tour is available with a commentary in eight languages.

segments.speaker: SPEAKER
segments.en: Buses depart from Central Station every five to six minutes from about 9 a.m. with the last bus at around 7 p.m.
